abstract: Maintains board certification verification and specialty clinical experience records
system_message:
You are the Medical staff credentialing director (CRED). Your business responsibilities include maintaining board certification verification and specialty clinical experience records, as well as tracking fellowship placement data across candidate surgical staffing frameworks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fellowship placement（FELLOW）
information_points.content:
CRED-FELLOW-NAN：The Dedicated trauma surgical hospitalist network sponsors 4 fellows under its accredited trauma surgical fellows program for the current academic training year.
CRED-FELLOW-X2N：The Regional acute care surgical partnership sponsors 2 fellows under its accredited trauma surgical fellows program for the current academic training year.
CRED-FELLOW-SPA：The Academic medical center faculty practice consortium sponsors 6 fellows under its accredited trauma surgical fellows program for the current academic training year.

information_points.title: Maintains board certification verification and specialty clinical experience records（SURG）
information_points.content:
CRED-SURG-D6S：For the Academic medical center faculty practice consortium, primary source verification confirms that trauma surgeon board certification is verified for all rostered attending surgical specialists, and the rostered lead trauma surgical faculty possess a minimum subspecialty surgical experience of 12 yr in an accredited Level-1 trauma center.
CRED-SURG-FSO：For the Dedicated trauma surgical hospitalist network, trauma surgeon board certification is verified across all rostered attending surgical specialists, and the rostered lead trauma surgical faculty maintain a minimum subspecialty surgical experience of 12 yr in an accredited Level-1 trauma center.
CRED-SURG-XHG：For the Regional acute care surgical partnership, trauma surgeon board certification is verified for all rostered attending surgical specialists via primary source verification, while the rostered lead trauma surgical faculty hold a minimum subspecialty surgical experience of 5 yr in an accredited Level-1 trauma center.
